notes: Pacts is a public, deterministic guild strategy game on a 12x12 map. Realm uses 3600-second epochs and 604800-second seasons (168 epochs), a troop price of 1000000000000000000 token minor units (1 PACT), and a 1000-basis-point purchase fee for season prizes. Guilds precedes Realm. Realm creates Diplomacy and Season in its constructor; Season creates Banners. Their addresses are available through Realm.diplomacy(), Realm.season(), and Season.banners(). These child contracts must not be deployed again as separate manifest entries: their constructors bind authority to their creating parent, and only Season can mint Banners. Wiring requires no initialization calls or constructor ETH. No owner wallet or post-deployment administrator is required. Game payouts are funded by player payments. The pool pairs with native ETH and has no hook; initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 (2^96). A pinned policy with an opening market capitalization determines the effective opening price. Policy and signed artifact linkage are supplied by the launch services.
